notes.subject: רגע
notes.rationale: a kɔrɔ bɛ se ka kɛ 'kɔgɔji weiraya' (ASV/JPS) walima 'a bɛ kɔgɔji ma hɛrɛ' (Geneva); daɲɛ in bɛɛ bɛ fɔ tiɲɛ-ni-caya fila

notes.subject: רהב
notes.rationale: Rahab: kɔgɔji la dugukolo jɛgɛnbaga tɔgɔ (Jps) walima 'sebagatigi' cogo-kɔrɔ (KJV); an ye tɔgɔ mara ni ɲɛfɔli-faralen ye

notes.subject: Rahab
notes.rationale: tɔgɔ in bɛ Sifa 51:10 ani Esayi 51:9 kɔnɔ ni kɔgɔji-jɛgɛnbaga ye — a bɛ Ejipto walima bɛnbaga minnu bɛ kɔgɔji kɔnɔ jira

translation: A se fɛ, kɔgɔji bɛ weiraya; a dɔnniya fɛ, a ye ⟨את⟩ Rahab (kɔgɔji ka sebagatigi) futu.
